title: Portuguese Chickpea Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful Portuguese-inspired fritter recipe made with chickpeas and nutty flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the chickpeas using a fork or a potato masher.
Add the flour, nutty bread, egg, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough mixture into the hot oil, about 1/4 cup each.
Fry the fritters for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters warm, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
